statement: The Commercial Code sets no minimum share capital for a private limited company: § 136 states only that share capital is denominated in euros, and the minimum nominal value of one share is one cent, with greater nominal values exact multiples of a cent (§ 148(1), (2)). The founders must pay for the shares in full before the petition for entry in the commercial register is submitted (§ 140(2)).
caveat: The former 2,500-euro capital floor was removed by the commercial-register reform in force 2023-02-01 (RT I, 05.05.2022, 1), which also repealed foundation without making contributions (the old § 140¹). A credit or payment institution's notice of share-capital payment accompanies the registration petition only where the contribution exceeds 50,000 euros (§ 144(1) clause 3).
